harper: opening a small smoke for mercury-compact-2 (512d) onboarding. target checks: recall@1/5/10, small-query slice, and cluster overlap. running a 4k mixed wiki+support sample.
lucas: baseline?
harper: comparing against beacon-base-v2 and ember-lite-512 we used last quarter. quant plan: int8 PTQ first, then try INT4-perchannel if int8 looks good.
mei: remember to test metric choices — dot vs cosine — and index configs (ivf vs hnsw). small dims can be sensitive.
harper: initial int8 (ivf, raw dot) quick numbers:
Recall@1: mercury 0.62 | ember-lite 0.69 | beacon 0.74
Recall@5: 0.84 | 0.88 | 0.91
Recall@10: 0.90 | 0.93 | 0.95
Cluster overlap (pairwise Jaccard top clusters): mercury 0.18 | ember-lite 0.13
Avg cluster size stdev: mercury 11.8 | ember-lite 9.2
sidd: @1 gap notable. can you paste a few short-query misses?
harper: short failures:
- "order refund" -> got "billing limits" (expect "refund process")
- "printer offline" -> got "driver install" (expect "connectivity troubleshooting")
- "cancel subscription" -> got "returns policy" (expect "account cancel")
mei: try L2-normalize + cosine for kNN. also run a short-query prompt augmentation — prefix short queries with "Q:" at embed time.
lucas: kicking off a cosine+norm job with ivf_flat and nlist=2048, batchsize 64. evalbot: queued job job_2026_03_22_mercury_01; sample=4k; configs=[mercury-int8-cosine-aug, mercury-int4-perch, ember-lite-int8]. ETA ~ 7m.
embedbot: automated eval finished for mercury-int8-cosine-aug:
Recall@1: 0.68
Recall@5: 0.86
Recall@10: 0.92
Cluster overlap: 0.12
Median intra-cluster cosine: 0.69

harper: nice — cosine + augmentation reduced the @1 gap and lowered overlap. two of three short failures now fixed.
sidd: int4 result?
embedbot: int4-perchannel run: Recall@1 0.55; Recall@5 0.80. too noisy for canary.
mei: looks like metric mismatch was the main issue. plan suggestion: promote mercury-int8-cosine-aug to a 5% read-only canary, fallback to ember-lite when recall@1 delta <= -0.04 for 30m. add a short-query HR@1 monitor and a cluster-overlap alert if overlap >0.15.
lucas: +1. include a perf check p50 microbatch=32 in the rollout PR. also attach UMAP snapshot for the overlapping clusters.
harper: will open PR with artifacts, UMAP, and monitor hooks. thanks all. :rocket: 
mei: tiny follow-up — add a 200-example short-query promptset to the monitoring suite and include multilingual checks (es/fr).
harper: added to checklist. closing thread once PR is up. :thumbsup:
